info.title: List Video Generation Tasks
info.description: Filter parameters to query matching video generation tasks. Only supports the last 7 days of task records, time range [T-7 days, T), where T is the UTC timestamp (seconds) of the request.

get.description:
Filter parameters to query matching video generation tasks. Only supports the last 7 days of task records, time range [T-7 days, T), where T is the UTC timestamp (seconds) of the request.

> Note: The following parameters are Query String Parameters, passed in the URL string.

parameters.name: page_num
parameters.description: The page number of the results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The number of results displayed per page.

parameters.name: filter.status
parameters.description:
Filter parameter to query tasks by status.

- queued: Tasks in queue.
- running: Running tasks.
- cancelled: Cancelled tasks.
- succeeded: Successful tasks.
- failed: Failed tasks.

parameters.name: filter.task_ids
parameters.description: Video generation task ID, exact search, supports searching multiple task IDs simultaneously. Pass by repeating the parameter name, e.g.: `filter.task_ids=id1&filter.task_ids=id2`.

parameters.name: filter.model
parameters.description: Unlike the response parameter, this field is the inference endpoint ID used by the task, exact search.

parameters.name: filter.service_tier
parameters.description: The service tier used to process the task. `default` means online inference, `flex` means offline inference.

200.description: Query successful, returns a list of video generation tasks matching the filter criteria.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

items.description: The list of video generation tasks found.

total.description: The number of tasks matching the filter criteria.

model.description: The model name and version used by the task, in `model_name-version` format.

status.description:
Task status.

- queued: In queue.
- running: Task running.
- cancelled: Task cancelled (only queued tasks can be cancelled).
- succeeded: Task successful.
- failed: Task failed.
- expired: Task timed out.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of task creation time.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the current status update time.

seed.description: The seed integer value used for this request.

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video.

ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video.

duration.description: The duration of the generated video, in seconds. Only one of `duration` and `frames` will be returned. If `frames` was not specified in the task creation, `duration` is returned.

frames.description: The number of frames of the generated video. Only one of `duration` and `frames` will be returned. If `frames` was specified in the task creation, `frames` is returned.

framespersecond.description: The frame rate of the generated video.

generate_audio.description:
Whether the generated video contains synchronized audio. Only returned for Seedance 2.0 series and Seedance 1.5 pro.

- true: The output video contains synchronized audio.
- false: The output video has no audio.

tools.description: The tools actually used by the model for this request. Not returned if no tools were used.

safety_identifier.description: Unique identifier of the end user. If this parameter was set when creating the video generation task, the API returns it as-is.

priority.description: The execution priority of the current request.

draft.description:
Whether the generated video is a Draft video. Only returned for Seedance 1.5 pro.

- true: The current output is a Draft video.
- false: The current output is a normal video.

draft_task_id.description: Draft video task ID. Returned when generating the final video based on a Draft video.

service_tier.description: The actual service tier used to process the task.

TaskError.description: Error message. Returns null on success, returns error data on failure.

VideoTaskContent.description: When the video generation task is complete, this field is output, containing the download URL of the generated video.

video_url.description: The URL of the generated video.

last_frame_url.description: The URL of the video's last frame image. Returned when `return_last_frame=true` is set during task creation.

type.description:
The type of tool actually used.

- web_search: Web search tool.

completion_tokens.description: The number of tokens consumed by the model for video generation, used for billing reconciliation. Seedance 2.0 series models have a minimum token usage limit. If actual token usage < minimum token usage, this field returns the minimum token usage, and billing is based on the minimum.

total_tokens.description: The total number of tokens consumed for this request. Video generation models do not count input tokens (input tokens = 0), so `total_tokens = completion_tokens`.

web_search.description: The actual number of web search calls, only returned when web search is enabled.
